name: homebridge-teufel-raumfeld
description: Control Teufel Raumfeld multiroom speakers from Apple HomeKit, with AirPlay streaming from iOS.
author: Alexander Peither

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run lint && npm run build

//dependencies-note: Kept deliberately small. SOAP is hand-rolled over global fetch and SSDP M-SEARCH over node:dgram (src/ssdpClient.ts, replacing the unmaintained node-ssdp and its vulnerable `ip` transitive dep); only /getZones and UPnP device-description XML need fast-xml-parser. AirPlay reception is an external shairport-sync process spawned by src/airplayBridge.ts, not a library.
